_icons: Inline icons: {power} Power Up (gold gem), {mana} Mana (purple gem), {gain} Gain a card (green card), {draw} Draw a card (blue card), {ult} Ultimate charge (blue orb), {disc} Discard effect (card with red arrow), {init} Initiative (lightning), {fire} {water} {earth} element cards, {wiz} wizard crest. Lines are the card's text lines; 'sub' is the line above the title. {blast} Blast Token (plain gold octagon, Robot Boy). Lines starting with ~ are the blue Tier lines. Traps: 'trigger' (TRIGGER:), 'text' (EFFECT:), 'after'.

dart.title: Magic Dart
dart.flavor: Fire magic is often banned from use in many parts of the world, due to its unpredictable nature.

block.title: Block
text: Gain {init}. Heal 1 for every {fire} card revealed.
block.flavor: "He just needs a little splash, is all he needs." – The Splashmaster

pgem.title: Power Gem
text: If you gained a card, discard it.
pgem.flavor: The golden gems of the Spell Storm take time to develop their power.

essF.title: Fire Essence
text: Deal 1 damage. You may gain any Tier I or II {fire} card in the Storm Cloud. VOID this.
essF.flavor: Fire Magic is generally associated with destruction.

essW.title: Water Essence
text: {mana}. You may gain any Tier I or II {water} card in the Storm Cloud. VOID this.
essW.flavor: Water Magic is generally associated with healing.

essE.title: Earth Essence
text: {power}. You may gain any Tier I or II {earth} card in the Storm Cloud. VOID this.
essE.flavor: Earth Magic is generally associated with building.

coffee.title: Coffee Run
text: If you gained an {earth} card, gain {init}.
coffee.flavor: "This is gonna be the best coffee run of all time!"

charge.title: Reckless Charge
text: Deal 1 damage. Gain an ASH. If you have {init}, deal 1 more damage.
charge.flavor: "I know we can do it if we work together!"

punch.title: Face Punch
text: Gain {init}. Steal 1 mana from a player and they discard a card randomly. {ult}
punch.flavor: "We use voices to avoid having to use fists. We use fists to avoid having to use bombs."

riot.title: Riot
text: Discard your hand without triggering any discard effects. Deal 1 damage per each {earth} discarded. {draw}{draw}{ult}.
riot.flavor: "Destroying the Omni-Gem was only the first step in our struggle against colonial oppression."

twopow.title: Two Power
twopow.flavor: When you see the "Gain Card" icon on a card, keep in mind that you may choose not to gain a card.

opal.title: Opal
opal.flavor: Gems are rocks found deep in the earth that are charged with mysterious power.

sift.title: Sift
text: {power}. Look at the top 2 cards of your deck. You may choose to discard them or place back on top of your deck in any order.
sift.flavor: Almost all Earth cards have discard effects.

diamond.title: Diamond
text: Discard exactly 3 cards. If you did,
diamond.flavor: "Learned more spells in 1 day at the Spellstorm, than I had in the past 3 years." – Azura Spellstorm Scholar

spirit.title: Spirit Crystal
text: {draw}. Reveal an {earth} from your hand. Resolve it and then discard it.
spirit.flavor: It's said that Earth magic is the oldest form of magic, which is why so many stones are imbued with powers.

amber.title: Amber
amber.flavor: The Business Demons considered drilling operations at the Spellstorm, but it was deemed too costly.

shatter.title: Shatter
text: VOID up to 2 cards from your hand. {power} for each you VOIDED.
shatter.flavor: "That there spellstorm water's FULL—a gold, I tell ya!" – Prospector

meteor.title: Meteorite
text: Take 1 damage. You may resolve any card from the Storm Cloud regardless of tier and then VOID it.
meteor.flavor: "Mom! Look! This fell from the sky!" – A child of Tiya Bannet

blood.title: Bloodstone
text: Take 1 damage. You may VOID a card from your hand or discard.
blood.flavor: "It's best to leave gems that you find in the wild alone, unless you really know what you're doing." – Abragail

quake.title: Quake
text: Opponents lose 2 Power Tokens and gain an ASH. {gain}
quake.flavor: A huge earthquake that happened in 1951 is attributed to the emergence of the Business Demons.

threepow.title: Three Power
threepow.flavor: When you see the "Gain Card" icon on a card, keep in mind that you may choose not to gain a card.

swamp.title: Swamp Silt
text: {draw}. The player with {init} loses it. Give opponents a CURSE.
swamp.flavor: The Order's imperial land-grab has much to do with the increasing swampland in their territory.

lavabat.title: Lava Bat
text: {mana}. You may move a non-Wizard {fire} card from any discard to any other discard.
lavabat.flavor: Dangerous flaming bats have been known to fly out of the volcanic activity of the Spellstorm.

ruby.title: Ruby
text: Discard the top 3 cards of your deck. Deal 1 damage per {fire} card discarded
OR you may VOID one of the discarded cards.
ruby.flavor: The popular trend of ruby-adorned garments was blamed for the Great Royal Ball Fire of 1976.

shock.title: Shockwave
text: Chosen player loses 2 Power Tokens, discards a random card, loses {init} and takes 1 damage.
shock.flavor: The 1981 hit song "Shockwave" is often credited with creating the Bonepunk genre.

rapid.title: Rapid Fire
text: If you have {init}, deal 2 damage and you may redraw this to your hand.
rapid.flavor: When going for a fire-based strategy, it's important to keep the pressure on.

obsidian.title: Obsidian
text: Take 1 damage and lose 2 mana. If you did, you may {ult} without paying the mana cost.
obsidian.flavor: "Whenever I close my eyes, I see my twisted reflection in that black mirrored gem." – Unknown

lantern.title: Lantern
text: If the next clockwise player revealed {water}, VOID this, you gain a CURSE and take 1 damage.
lantern.flavor: Do not keep sentient fire spirits trapped in a lantern, for any reason.

heart.title: Heart Gem
heart.flavor: The Heart Gem has surfaced and disappeared many times throughout history, bringing a deadly curse each time.

manafont.title: Mana Font
text: VOID a {water} in the Storm Cloud. If you did, {mana}{mana}{mana}.
manafont.flavor: While there are many theories, no one knows where the magic inside gems originally comes from.

flame.title: Flame
text: Deal 1 damage and then resolve and discard a different {fire} from your hand.
flame.flavor: You need *magic* water to put a magical flame out.

fb2.title: Fireball II
text: Deal 2 damage. If you have {init}, deal 2 more damage.
fb2.flavor: It is customary to say "shaboom-ya!" when one reveals the Fireball II card.

cross.title: Crossfire
text: If you have {init}, deal 3 damage to a chosen opponent, lose {init} and then place this in that opponent's discard.
cross.flavor: "The first lesson in using fire magic always must be... how not to burn one's self." – B Underbrom, Professor of Fire Magic

fb.title: Fireball
text: Deal 1 damage and gain an ASH. If you have {init}, deal 2 more damage and lose {init}.
fb.flavor: It is customary to say "shaboom!" when one reveals the Fireball card.

arctite.title: Arctite
arctite.flavor: Pirates have been known to smuggle large amounts of Arctite inside icebergs.

iceflume.title: Ice Flume
text: Give an ICE. You may VOID an ICE from your hand or discard. Gain {init}.

frost.title: Frost Magic
text: Heal 1. Lose 1 Power Token. Give opponents an ICE.
frost.flavor: The Azure Order was focused on water magic until the 1970s, when ice magic suddenly became far more popular.

lapis.title: Lapis
text: {draw}. You may discard up to 2 cards.
lapis.flavor: Doctors throughout Omia have used Water Magic to heal the sick for generations.

leap.title: Leap
text: If an opponent revealed {fire}, you may VOID a card from your hand or discard.
leap.flavor: Azure wizards historically specialized in Water Gems, but they have since taken others from throughout the globe.

moon.title: Moonstone
moon.flavor: The rare and beautiful Moonstone is one of the most coveted in all of Omia.

reflect.title: Reflect
reflect.flavor: "He just needs a little splash, is all he needs." – The Splashmaster

sapph.title: Sapphire
sapph.flavor: Many of Omia's most impressive Wizards have a signature move, which some call an "Ultimate".

step.title: Step
step.flavor: From the year 366–1182, the Water Kingdom reigned over much of the Eastern Continent.

ultw.title: Ultimate
text: You may VOID an {earth} from your hand.
ultw.flavor: "He just needs a little splash, is all he needs." – The Splashmaster

wave.title: Wave
text: {mana}{mana}{mana}. Chosen player discards their hand and draws a new hand of 4 cards.

dEarth.title: Earth Dragon
text: {gain}{gain}. Deal 2 damage. Gain 1 Storm Shard. Opponents gain an ASH. {ult}
dEarth.flavor: The Earth Dragons are known to hoard massive amounts of treasure in caves.

dFire.title: Fire Dragon
dFire.flavor: No Dragon is more feared than the destructive and terrible Fire Dragon.

dIce.title: Ice Dragon
text: Heal 3. Gain 1 Storm Shard. Give an ICE. {ult}
dIce.flavor: The elusive Storm Dragons were considered to be cryptids until very recently.

dStorm.title: Storm Dragon
text: Deal 3 damage and gain 1 Storm Shard. {ult}
dStorm.flavor: The elusive Storm Dragons were considered to be cryptids until very recently.

dWind.title: Wind Dragon
text: Gain {init}. Gain a Storm Shard. You may resolve up to two cards from your hand. {ult}
dWind.flavor: The elusive Storm Dragons were considered to be cryptids until very recently.

ice.title: Ice
text: {disc}: −1 to Blast Score (if discarded during the Regroup Phase.)
ice.flavor: "Ice cut into a cube shape is kind of like a gem." – Beosnook

ash.title: Ash
ash.flavor: The Spellstorm is a highly volcanic area, often covered in ash.

curse.title: Curse
curse.flavor: "Curses!" – H.M.T. Holliganger, Distinguished Professor at the Azura Academy School of Archaeology

trap_mud.title: Mud Trap
trap_mud.flavor: Omar is part of a secretive collective of ninja assassins that roam the Cloister forests.
trap_mud.trigger: You may reveal this if you COUNTER with a {fire} card.
trap_mud.after: After revealing, leave this card here. It is inactive.

trap_dodge.title: Dodge!
trap_dodge.flavor: Omar's species, known as the Zuzuni, are bipedal insectoids that have been oppressed by the Azure Order for most of recorded history.
trap_dodge.trigger: You may reveal this when an opponent is dealing damage to you.
text: The first 2 points of damage you take this round are negated.
trap_dodge.after: After revealing, leave this card here. It is inactive.

trap_ice.title: Ice Bomb
trap_ice.flavor: After seeing a vision of Croh Vosh taking the power of the Spellstorm, Omar has come here to stop it before it happens.
trap_ice.trigger: You may reveal this if you COUNTER with a {water} card.
trap_ice.after: After revealing, leave this card here. It is inactive.

potiongun.title: Potion Gun
text: Deal 1 damage. You may give a non-Wizard card from your hand to an opponent's hand. If you did, gain 2 of the Element matching that card. {ult}
potiongun.flavor: "Think I can hit that old barrel by the hill over there?"

unstable.title: Unstable Formula
text: {power}{mana}. Lower any one Element by 2 to raise another by 2. If anyone revealed {water}, +1 Earth Element. {ult}
unstable.flavor: "Oh, it'll work, trust me. But, uh... you might wanna stand back a bit..."

beetle.title: Beetle Buster
text: Discard a {fire} from your hand to deal 2 damage.
beetle.flavor: A hero to many, Omar is regarded by the powerful as an eco-terrorist.

shuriken.title: Shuriken
text: SPECIAL: this card ALWAYS goes first.
Gain {init}, {draw} OR chosen opponent discards their revealed card (it does not resolve) and they {draw}. {ult}.

undertow.title: Undertow
text: Opponents discard a random card. You {draw}. If you have at least 3 more cards than another player, gain a DOOM Token. {ult}
undertow.flavor: Croh has come to the Spellstorm seeking his path to world domination.

sinking.title: Sinking Strike
text: {mana}{mana}. Deal X damage, where X is your number of DOOM Tokens. If the CURSE pile is empty, gain a DOOM Token. {ult}
sinking.flavor: Long ago, Croh Vosh was betrayed and killed at Dragon Bridge by his longtime ally, Salutaire Ruupart.

deepgems.title: Deep Gems
text: {draw}{mana} You may lose 1 Power Token. If you did, resolve and then VOID a {water} from the Storm Cloud. {ult}
deepgems.flavor: The Water Kingdom's dominance was possible, in part, due to their ability to dredge resources from the deep.

curriculum.title: New Curriculum
text: {power} X times, where X is your current Tier. You may VOID up to 2 cards in the Storm Cloud. {gain}. {ult}
curriculum.flavor: "Can't believe the *garbage* I'm asked to teach sometimes!"

starshot.title: Star Shot
text: Discard a card to deal 1 damage. If it was Tier II, deal 1 more damage. {mana} for each Energy Token you have. Lose 2 Energy Tokens. {ult}

databreach.title: Data Breach
text: Lose 1 or 2 Energy Tokens. If you did, {power} that many times. If you still have 2 Energy Tokens, chosen opponent reveals their hand and they discard a card of your choice. {ult}
databreach.flavor: "Yes! I'm in. Now let's see what these idiots have planned next..."

buddy.title: Buddy System
text: Tier I players {power}. You {power}{mana}. You may resolve a different revealed {earth} card.
buddy.flavor: "Bunny is wondering if it would be okay to hold your hand." – Bunny's Handler

snowday.title: Snow Day
text: Heal 2. Give an ICE to all opponents without any in their discard.
snowday.flavor: The Stuffies are a species of stuffed animals that have been brought to life by powerful Star magic.

rb_repair.title: Robot Boy
text: ~Tier II: VOID an ICE or CURSE in Robot Boy's discard.

rb_bounce.title: Robot Boy
text: Resolve and then VOID the "X" card in the Storm Cloud.
~Tier II: If Robot Boy has {init}, deal 2 damage.

rb_laser.title: Robot Boy
text: Gain {init}. Deal 1 damage. Robot Boy discards a Blast Token.

rb_fist.title: Robot Boy
text: {mana}. Robot Boy discards a Blast Token. Deal 1 damage.

rb_upgrade.title: Robot Boy
text: VOID the "X" card in the Storm Cloud.

rb_hack.title: Robot Boy
text: ~Tier II: Other players discard a card randomly.

rb_drill.title: Robot Boy
text: Opponents who revealed {water} gain an ASH.

beetle_2e.flavor: A hero to many, Omar is regarded by the powerful as an eco-terrorist.

undertow_2e.title: Undertow
text: {draw}. Opponents discard two random cards. If you COUNTERED, gain a DOOM Token. {ult}
undertow_2e.flavor: Croh has come to the Spellstorm seeking his path to world domination.

w_dust.title: Dust Cloud
text: {draw}. {power}. All players discard a random card.

w_ewave.title: Energy Wave
text: {draw}. After resolving their cards here, players may use their Ultimate ability (still need the required mana).

w_glitter.title: Glittering Dust
text: {draw}{draw}. {earth} cards do nothing when resolved but Heal 2.

w_ionic.title: Ionic Atmosphere
text: {draw}{draw}. All players {mana}. Tier II and III players lose 2 Power Tokens.

w_lightning.title: Lightning Strike!
text: {draw}. All players {mana}. Players with more than 8 health take 1 damage.

w_soothe.title: Soothing Rain
text: {draw}. Each player may VOID an ASH, CURSE or ICE in their hand or discard pile.

w_strange.title: Strange Weather
text: {draw}, {draw}. Discard the next card in the Weather Deck.

w_toads.title: Rain of Toads
text: {draw}. The player with {init} loses it. Whoever gets it gains a CURSE and {mana}.

w_warp.title: Magnetic Warp
text: {draw}{draw}. VOID all cards in the Storm Cloud and draw out 5 new ones.

w_wild.title: Wildcolor Winds
text: {draw}. All players draw a card from the Storm Deck and place it face up in their discard (don't trigger discard effects).

pot_delixir.title: "Dragon Elixir"
text: Resolve the top card of the Dragon Deck.

pot_devil.title: "Devil's Breath"
pot_devil.toxicNote: If this is your third TOXIC card, end your ultimate and gain an ASH, POISON and ICE.

pot_explo.title: "A Slight... Explosion"
text: Deal 1 damage. Gain 1 of each element.
pot_explo.toxicNote: If this is your third TOXIC card, end your ultimate and gain an ASH, POISON and ICE.

text: Take 1 damage. Your next Potion Card's effect happens twice (pay the cost once.)
pot_gas.toxicNote: If this is your third TOXIC card, end your ultimate and gain an ASH, POISON and ICE.

text: If you have {init}, deal 1 damage. Otherwise, gain {init}.

pot_purple.title: "I Call It... Purple Stuff."
pot_purple.toxicNote: If this is your third TOXIC card, end your ultimate and gain an ASH, POISON and ICE.
